question: Which state government has launched the CHHATA scheme to improve groundwater table in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Odisha govt **has launched a rainwater harvesting scheme named **‘Community Harnessing and Harvesting Rainwater Artificially from Terrace to Aquifer (CHHATA)’.**
 
• It has been conceptualized to address the increasing stress on groundwater and to improve the depleting groundwater table.
 
• Under the scheme, a target has been set to harvest **373.52 crore liters of water in five years.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian state **Odisha was **established on** 1 April 1936.**
 
• The organization Utkal Sammilani was formed in 1903 to demand the unification of Odia-speaking regions into one state.
 
• The Province of Bihar and Orissa was formed on **1 April 1912.**
 
• Bihar and Orissa were subdivided into separate provinces on **1 April 1936.**
 
• The new Province of Orissa was created on a linguistic basis during the British rule in India, with Sir John Austen Hubback as the first governor.
 
• On 15 August 1947, the agreement to join Orissa was signed by **27 princely States.**
